newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept machine tool orders up 15.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept machine tool orders up 15.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's machine tool orders jumped 15.4 percent in September from a year earlier to 83.55 billion yen, the Japan Machine Tool Builders' Association said on Thursday.
The figure was up 13.1 percent from August, it said.
Orders for numerically controlled machine tools, which accounted for the bulk of the total, rose 18.4 percent in September from a year earlier to 75.19 billion yen.
Foreign orders in September were up 2.7 percent from a year earlier at 36.03 billion yen, while domestic orders soared 27.3 percent to 47.52 billion yen.
